title: The Rule of One Clear Outcome
short_teaser: Projects become difficult when they carry several competing definitions of success.
story: Projects become difficult when they carry several competing definitions of success. Naming one primary outcome helps people make tradeoffs. Clarity about the main result reduces conflict among secondary goals. Strategy is choosing what matters most, learning from evidence, and placing limited effort where it can create the greatest useful change. The lasting value is not merely knowing the fact. It is seeing the pattern beneath it and considering where that same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
impact: Clarity about the main result reduces conflict among secondary goals. Strategy is choosing what matters most, learning from evidence, and placing limited effort where it can create the greatest useful change.
spark_application: Identify the decision underneath your current activity. Choose the smallest next move that would create useful information. Save a short note about what you noticed, what surprised you, or what you may want to revisit.
